attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 6, `proB` to `yafP`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 8% of calls. The model names 78 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 6, `yafP`, 78%.

**A fork follows at `yafO`**, column 7, carried by 66%, then variable column 8, `yafN`, 70%. The spine returns at columns 15 to 20, `dpaA` to `yafV`, the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 22 to 46%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 92 against 89%, and hesitates less there, 0.48 against 0.55 bits. It hesitates most at column 22, a fork column, 2.19 bits.

**The window ends in variable columns.** Columns 68 to 79, `cdaR` to `fhuB`, are carried by 13 to 38%, all persistent. The last column is `fhuB`, in 13% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 89% of genes**, 0.53 bits on average, perplexity 1.8 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.19 against 0.23 bits, and names fewer genes, 74% against 96%.

label: proB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the proB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor proB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,453 to 3,532 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying proB once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.53 bits on average (perplexity 1.8 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 26,715 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; shell 15,525 calls, named 78%, 0.97 bits; cloud 880 calls, named 25%, 3.91 bits. Outside an RGP 29,580 calls, named 96%, 0.23 bits; inside an RGP 13,540 calls, named 74%, 1.19 bits. Columns: 16 spine, 36 fork, 28 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.19 against 0.23 bits) and names fewer genes (74% against 96%); 13,540 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 22 ("DUF4367 domain-containing protein", a fork column) 2.19 bits, RGP 74%; column 21 (ydcC, a fork column) 1.95 bits, RGP 70%; column 23 (dnaQ, a fork column) 1.77 bits, RGP 76%. The 22 columns (columns 21-42) where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 0.85 bits on average; the other 58 columns: named 92%, 0.42 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 16 spine columns: named 92%, 0.48 bits on average; the 64 fork and variable columns: named 89%, 0.55 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 22, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 15-20 (spine), RGP 22-46%; the least: columns 0-6 (spine), RGP 0-8%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-6 (7 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0-8%. Genes: proB, phoE, crl, frsA, gpt, pepD, yafP "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase". named 78-99.8% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6 (yafP), named 78%, 1.69 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 7-8 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: share 66-70%, all S, RGP 9%. named 88-95% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 7, named 88%, 0.95 bits.
[S2.c7]    7 fork: yafO S 66% "type II toxin-antitoxin system mRNA…"; also ykfJ S 23%
[S2.c8]    8 variable: yafN S 70% "type I toxin-antitoxin system antit…"
[S3] 3. columns 9-10 (2 columns) spine: share 94-95%, all P, RGP 11-12%. Genes: dinB, lafU. named 89-94% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 9 (dinB), named 89%; most hesitant at column 10 (lafU), 0.72 bits.
[S4] 4. column 11 fork: share 75%, all S, RGP 20%. named 85%; 0.73 bits.
[S4.c11]    11: rayT S 75%; also motA S 17%
[S5] 5. column 12 spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 21%. Genes: yafL "C40 family peptidase". named 92%; 0.59 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 13-14 (2 columns) fork: share 50-66%, all S, RGP 22%. named 87-89% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 14, named 87%, 0.50 bits.
[S6.c13]    13: dinJ S 66%; also "flagellar basal body-associated FliL fa…" S 16%

[S8] 8. columns 21-79 (59 columns) fork and variable columns: share 13-83%, 56 P, 3 S, RGP 12-76%. named 65-94% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 21, named 65%; most hesitant at column 22, 2.19 bits.
